subject: ela
cluster: Research to build and present knowledge
intro: Pick the best note or fact.

items.prompt:
A good NOTE is:
A) a short record of a key fact in your own words
B) the whole paragraph copied
C) a drawing only
items.answer: A) a short record of a key fact in your own words

steps: Short, own words. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) a short record of a key fact in your own words

items.prompt:
Read.

Spiders have eight legs.

The best note is:
A) Spiders: 8 legs
B) Spiders are animals that have eight legs and live in many places and spin webs
C) I like spiders

steps: Short key fact. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Notes should be written in:
A) your own words
B) a secret code
C) another language

Read.

The desert is very dry and gets little rain.

The best note is:
A) Desert: dry, little rain
B) The desert is a place that is very, very dry
C) deserts

steps: Short key fact. Key is A.

items.prompt:
We can gather information from:
A) only one book
B) books, websites, and our own experiences
C) nothing
items.answer: B) books, websites, and our own experiences

solution.answer: B) books, websites, and our own experiences

items.prompt:
Why do we take SHORT notes instead of copying everything?
A) To keep only the key facts
B) To waste time
C) To hide the facts
items.answer: A) To keep only the key facts

steps: Notes are brief. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) To keep only the key facts

items.prompt:
Read.

Elephants use their trunks to drink water, grab food, and greet other elephants.

The BEST note is:
A) Trunk: drink, grab food, greet
B) Elephants are very large animals that live in Africa and Asia and have trunks
C) I saw an elephant
items.answer: A) Trunk: drink, grab food, greet

steps: Short, key facts only. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) Trunk: drink, grab food, greet

items.prompt:
You have notes about a whale's size, food, and home. Sorting them into groups helps you:
A) organize your report
B) lose your notes
C) copy the book

steps: Grouping organizes writing. Key is A.
